title: Multi-Agent Egocentric World Model with Fine-Grained Embodied Interaction
title_zh: Multi-Agent Egocentric World Model with Fine-Grained Embodied Interaction

paragraphs.en: Egocentric world models predict first-person observations conditioned on an agent’s actions, but most focus on a single agent. Real embodied settings often involve multiple agents that act and interact within a shared environment. Existing multi-agent world models rely on coarse actions like locomotion, camera control, or discrete commands, leaving fine-grained embodied interactions underexplored. We formulate multi-agent egocentric world modeling as synchronized ego-stream generation for multiple agents interacting through fine-grained actions in a shared world. This requires cross-view action consistency, shared-environment consistency, and consistent propagation of interaction-induced state updates. We propose Multi-agent Egocentric World Model (ME-World) , which jointly denoises multiple ego streams in a shared token sequence, conditions each stream on all agents’ target-view poses, and grounds generation with shared environment memory. We train and evaluate on real and synthetic multi-agent data and introduce shared-world consistency metrics for environment, update, and identity consistency. Experiments show ME-World improves shared-world consistency, action control, identity preservation, and video quality over existing methods.
paragraphs.zh: 自我中心世界模型预测基于智能体行为的第一人称观察结果，但大多数研究仅关注单个智能体。 真实的具身化场景通常涉及多个在共享环境中行动和互动的智能体。 现有的多智能体世界模型依赖诸如移动、摄像头控制或离散命令等粗略动作，导致精细的具身化互动尚未得到充分探索。 我们将多智能体自我中心世界建模定义为：在共享世界中，通过精细动作相互作用的多个智能体的同步自我视角流生成。 这需要跨视角的动作一致性、共享环境一致性，以及由互动引发的状态更新的连贯传播。 我们提出了多智能体自我中心世界模型（ME-World），该模型在共享的标记序列中联合去噪多个自我视角流，以所有智能体的目标视角姿态为条件，并通过共享环境记忆对生成内容进行约束。 我们在真实和合成的多智能体数据上训练并评估了该模型，同时引入了用于衡量环境、更新和身份一致性的共享世界一致性指标。 实验表明，与现有方法相比，ME-World 在共享世界一致性、动作控制、身份保持和视频质量方面均有提升。

paragraphs.en: Video world models ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ) generate future observations conditioned on a user’s actions or controls, enabling an agent to imagine how a scene may evolve without acting in the real world. Such action-conditioned prediction has been widely explored in autonomous driving ( Gao et al., 2024 ) , robotics ( Kim et al., 2026b ; Ye et al., 2026 ) , open-domain world simulation ( NVIDIA et al., 2025 ; Ball et al., 2025 ) , and games ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2026 ) . Recent work has extended it to egocentric world modeling ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Hao et al., 2026 ) , where an embodied agent predicts its future first-person observations, or ego stream , conditioned on its own actions.
paragraphs.zh: 视频世界模型（Ha 和 Schmidhuber，2018）根据用户的操作或控制生成未来的观察结果，使智能体无需在现实世界中采取行动，也能想象场景可能如何演变。 这种以行动为条件的预测方法已在自动驾驶（Gao 等人，2024）、机器人学（Kim 等人，2026b；Ye 等人，2026）、开放域世界模拟（NVIDIA 等人，2025；Ball 等人，2025）以及游戏（Wang 等人，2026；Tang 等人，2026）等领域得到广泛探索。 近期的研究已将其扩展到以自我为中心的世界建模（Zhang 等人，2026；Hao 等人，2026），其中具身智能体根据自身的行动预测其未来的第一人称观察结果，即“自我流”。

paragraphs.en: Most existing egocentric world models ( Bai et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Gu et al., 2026 ; Pallotta et al., 2026 ; Xiu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) assume a single embodied ego, referred to as an agent , and capture how its actions shape its own future ego stream. In real-world settings, however, multiple agents often coexist and interact with one another and with shared objects, jointly changing a common, evolving state of the environment, objects, and agents, which we term the shared world state . A multi-agent world model must therefore make each interaction visible from every agent’s viewpoint and reflect the resulting state changes simultaneously across all observations.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数现有的自我中心世界模型（Bai et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026b；Gu et al., 2026；Pallotta et al., 2026；Xiu et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026）都假设存在一个具身的单一自我，即所谓的智能体，并描述其行动如何塑造自身未来的自我流。 然而，在现实世界中，多个智能体常常共存，并彼此互动，同时与共享对象相互作用，共同改变环境、物体和智能体的共同演化状态，我们将其称为共享世界状态。 因此，多智能体世界模型必须使每一次互动都能从每个智能体的视角中清晰呈现，并同步反映所有观察结果中由此产生的状态变化。

paragraphs.en: Recent multi-agent egocentric world models ( Savva et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026b ) extend egocentric world modeling to multiple agents in a shared environment. However, they mostly target domains where actions are abstracted into low-dimensional controls, such as discrete commands in multiplayer games ( Enigma team, 2025 ) , camera trajectories in driving and videos ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) , and robot control in manipulation ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . While such abstractions support multi-view generation under given controls, they fail to capture the dual role of fine-grained embodied actions as both first-person controls and cross-view observable events. In human interaction, body and hand motion, and head-induced viewpoint changes must remain consistent across agents, while the same interaction may also update shared objects and the environment.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的多智能体自我中心世界模型（Savva 等人，2026；Wu 等人，2026；Hu 等人，2026b）将自我中心世界建模扩展到了共享环境中的多个智能体。 然而，这些模型主要面向将动作抽象为低维控制的领域，例如多人游戏中的离散指令（Enigma 团队，2025）、驾驶和视频中的摄像头轨迹（Zhu 等人，2026；Sun 等人，2026），以及操作任务中的机器人控制（Liu 等人，2026）。 尽管这类抽象能够在给定控制下支持多视角生成，但它们未能捕捉到精细具身动作的双重角色——既是第一人称控制，也是跨视角可观察的事件。 在人类互动中，身体和手部的运动以及头部引起的视角变化必须在不同智能体之间保持一致，而同一互动也可能同时更新共享对象和环境。

paragraphs.en: We address this gap in embodied multi-agent settings as shown in Fig. 1 , which arise naturally in multi-agent generative VR ( Tu et al., 2026 ) , embodied AI simulation ( Puig et al., 2023 ) , and multi-robot collaboration ( Chen et al., 2026a ) . In these setting, the challenge goes beyond generating different viewpoints of a common world. (i) Cross-view actions must be synchronized, so that an agent’s action appears plausible in its own stream and matches how others observe it (Fig. 2 (a)). (ii) The shared environment must remain consistent, so that ego streams do not depict conflicting layouts, appearances, or objects (Fig. 2 (b)). (iii) Interaction-induced state changes must propagate to every ego stream rather than diverging into conflicting object states or outcomes (Fig. 2 (c)). We therefore ask: How can a world model generate multiple ego streams consistent with a single evolving shared world, while each agents observe, act, and interact differently?
paragraphs.zh: 我们针对具身多智能体设置中的这一空白提出了解决方案，如图 1 所示。这类问题在多智能体生成式 VR（Tu et al., 2026）、具身 AI 模拟（Puig et al., 2023）以及多机器人协作（Chen et al., 2026a）中自然出现。 在这些设置中，挑战不仅限于生成同一世界的不同视角。 (i) 跨视角的动作必须同步，以确保智能体的动作在其自身视角流中显得合理，并与他人观察到的情况一致（图 2(a)）。 (ii) 共享环境必须保持一致，以避免各自我视角流中出现相互冲突的布局、外观或物体（图 2(b)）。 (iii) 由交互引发的状态变化必须传播到所有自我视角流中，而不能演变为相互冲突的物体状态或结果（图 2(c)）。 因此，我们提出以下问题：一个世界模型如何能够生成多个与单一动态共享世界一致的自我视角流，同时每个智能体又能以不同的方式观察、行动和交互？

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we introduce M ulti-agent E gocentric World Model (ME-World) , which generates multiple ego streams as coupled observations of one shared world. Rather than generating each stream independently, ME-World performs joint multi-agent generation by denoising all streams in a shared token sequence, resolving interaction outcomes and state changes consistently across streams. To make this joint generation aware of embodied actions, we introduce shared action conditioning , which provides the target agent’s own motion and other agents’ motion observed from its stream. The generated streams are further grounded by shared environment memory , which provides view-aligned evidence by warping history observations into each target view, and common anchor references shared across all streams to maintain scene appearance. By coupling generation, action conditioning, and environment evidence across agents, ME-World maintains consistency in cross-view actions, shared environment, and interaction-induced state updates.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了多智能体自我中心世界模型（ME-World），该模型生成多个自我视角流，作为共享世界的耦合观测。 ME-World 并非独立生成每个视角流，而是通过在一个共享的标记序列中对所有视角流进行去噪，实现联合的多智能体生成，从而在各视角流中一致地解决交互结果和状态变化。 为了让这种联合生成能够感知具身化动作，我们引入了共享动作条件机制，该机制提供目标智能体自身的运动以及从其视角流中观测到的其他智能体的运动信息。 生成的视角流还通过共享环境记忆进一步锚定：该机制通过将历史观测数据变换到每个目标视角，提供与视角对齐的证据，并利用所有视角流共享的公共锚点参考来维持场景外观的一致性。 通过在智能体间耦合生成、动作条件与环境证据，ME-World 能够保持跨视角动作、共享环境以及交互引发的状态更新之间的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Learning this model requires synchronized multi-ego data sharing one world state. Existing egocentric datasets ( Grauman et al., 2022 ; Grauman et al., 2024 ; Sener et al., 2022 ; Rai et al., 2021 ; Sigurdsson et al., 2018 ; Damen et al., 2018 ; Jia et al., 2020 ; Ma et al., 2024 ) primarily capture single agents, or lack coverage of agent number, viewpoint diversity, interactions, and appearance variation. We therefore combine real multi-ego data ( Gavryushin et al., 2026 ) with synthetic multi-ego data ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2024 ) covering diverse agent configurations, environments, and interaction scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 训练该模型需要在一个世界状态中同步共享多智能体视角的数据。 现有的以自我为中心的数据集（Grauman 等，2022；Grauman 等，2024；Sener 等，2022；Rai 等，2021；Sigurdsson 等，2018；Damen 等，2018；Jia 等，2020；Ma 等，2024）主要只捕捉单个智能体，或者缺乏对智能体数量、视角多样性、交互和外观变化的覆盖。 因此，我们将真实的多人视角数据（Gavryushin 等，2026）与合成的多智能体视角数据（Xu 等，2024；Liang 等，2024）相结合，以涵盖多样化的智能体配置、环境和交互场景。

sents.en: Learning this model requires synchronized multi-ego data sharing one world state.
sents.zh: 训练该模型需要在一个世界状态中同步共享多智能体视角的数据。

sents.en: Existing egocentric datasets ( Grauman et al., 2022 ; Grauman et al., 2024 ; Sener et al., 2022 ; Rai et al., 2021 ; Sigurdsson et al., 2018 ; Damen et al., 2018 ; Jia et al., 2020 ; Ma et al., 2024 ) primarily capture single agents, or lack coverage of agent number, viewpoint diversity, interactions, and appearance variation.
sents.zh: 现有的以自我为中心的数据集（Grauman 等，2022；Grauman 等，2024；Sener 等，2022；Rai 等，2021；Sigurdsson 等，2018；Damen 等，2018；Jia 等，2020；Ma 等，2024）主要只捕捉单个智能体，或者缺乏对智能体数量、视角多样性、交互和外观变化的覆盖。

sents.en: We therefore combine real multi-ego data ( Gavryushin et al., 2026 ) with synthetic multi-ego data ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2024 ) covering diverse agent configurations, environments, and interaction scenarios.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将真实的多人视角数据（Gavryushin 等，2026）与合成的多智能体视角数据（Xu 等，2024；Liang 等，2024）相结合，以涵盖多样化的智能体配置、环境和交互场景。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we introduce an evaluation protocol for shared-world consistency . Existing evaluations measure video quality ( Unterthiner et al., 2019 ; Zhang et al., 2018 ) , control alignment ( Gu et al., 2026 ) , and cross-view consistency through geometric agreement or VLM-based judgments ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026b ; Savva et al., 2026 ) , but do not assess whether multiple ego streams consistently represent the same evolving shared world beyond directly provided input. We therefore propose S env S_{\mathrm{env}} , which measures whether newly generated environment regions remain consistent across ego streams, and S update S_{\mathrm{update}} , which measures whether interaction-induced state changes, such as a moved frying pan, are reflected consistently across views. On the synthetic benchmark, we further report S id S_{\mathrm{id}} for identity preservation with respect to ground-truth reference characters. These metrics complement quality and control metrics for evaluating embodied multi-agent world modeling.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们引入一种用于评估共享世界一致性的评价协议。 现有的评价方法会衡量视频质量（Unterthiner 等人，2019；Zhang 等人，2018）、控制对齐性（Gu 等人，2026），以及通过几何匹配或基于 VLM 的判断来评估跨视角一致性（Wu 等人，2026；Hu 等人，2026b；Savva 等人，2026），但并未检验多个自我视角流是否在直接提供的输入之外，仍能一致地表示同一个不断演变的共享世界。 因此，我们提出了 S env S_{\mathrm{env}}，用于衡量新生成的环境区域是否在不同自我视角流之间保持一致；以及 S update S_{\mathrm{update}}，用于衡量由交互引发的状态变化（例如被移动的煎锅）是否在不同视角中保持一致地反映出来。 在合成基准测试中，我们还报告了 S id S_{\mathrm{id}}，用于衡量与真实参考角色相比的身份保持能力。 这些指标为评估具身多智能体世界建模提供了对质量和控制指标的补充。

paragraphs.en: We introduce embodied multi-agent world modeling for synchronized ego stream generation among multiple agents interacting in a shared world. We propose ME-World , coupling streams via joint generation, shared action, and shared environment memory.

paragraphs.en: Egocentric World Models. Some egocentric world models condition on whole-body motion ( Bai et al., 2026 ; Tu et al., 2026 ; Pallotta et al., 2026 ) , fine-grained hand and camera control ( Xie et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) , or jointly generated body motion ( Xiu et al., 2026 ) . Others model human-world interaction through dexterous manipulation ( Kim et al., 2026a ; Goswami et al., 2026 ) , explicit 3D memory ( Gu et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026 ) , or goal-directed world evolution ( Hao et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ) . These focus on a single agent, whereas we model multiple embodied agents whose actions and interaction-induced changes remain consistent across ego views within a shared world.
paragraphs.zh: 自我中心世界模型。 一些自我中心世界模型以全身运动（Bai et al., 2026；Tu et al., 2026；Pallotta et al., 2026）、精细的手和相机控制（Xie et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026b），或联合生成的身体运动（Xiu et al., 2026）为条件。 另一些模型则通过灵巧操作（Kim et al., 2026a；Goswami et al., 2026）、显式的三维记忆（Gu et al., 2026；Yan et al., 2026），或目标导向的世界演化（Hao et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026；Shen et al., 2026）来模拟人与世界的互动。 这些模型专注于单个智能体，而我们对多个具身智能体进行建模，其行动以及由互动引发的变化在共享世界内的不同自我视角中保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent World Models. Recent video world models extend to multiple agents whose actions and observations are coupled through a shared environment, including multiplayer games ( Enigma team, 2025 ; Savva et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Po et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026a ) , driving ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , robotics ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , and open-domain videos ( Hu et al., 2026b ) . A challenge is maintaining a coherent world across controlled views, addressed via joint or cross-agent attention ( Savva et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) , shared scene representations ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , or shared memories and explicit world states ( Po et al., 2026 ; Mo et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, we study synchronized egocentric views of interacting humans, where fine-grained articulated actions must remain consistent across ego streams while affecting other agents and the shared environment.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体世界模型。 近期的视频世界模型已扩展至多个智能体，其动作与观察通过共享环境相互耦合，涵盖多人游戏（Enigma team, 2025；Savva et al., 2026；Wu et al., 2026；Liu et al., 2026；Po et al., 2026；Hu et al., 2026a）、驾驶（Zhu et al., 2026）、机器人技术（Wu et al., 2026；Liu et al., 2026）以及开放域视频（Hu et al., 2026b）。 一项挑战在于如何在不同受控视角下保持世界的一致性，这一问题可通过联合或跨智能体注意力机制（Savva et al., 2026；Sun et al., 2026；Hu et al., 2026b；Liu et al., 2026；Zhu et al., 2026）、共享场景表示（Wu et al., 2026），或共享记忆与显式世界状态（Po et al., 2026；Mo et al., 2026；Cai et al., 2026；Zhao et al., 2026；Xu et al., 2026）来解决。 相比之下，我们研究相互作用的人类的同步自我视角，其中精细的关节动作必须在各自我视角流中保持一致，同时影响其他智能体与共享环境。

paragraphs.en: ME-World addresses embodied multi-agent world modeling, where N N agents act and interact in the same evolving shared world while observing it from their own egocentric viewpoints. Given each agent’s future embodied action sequence, text prompt, initial ego frame and observation history, our goal is to generate future ego streams for all agents, with each stream following its own action and all streams remaining consistent with the same shared environment and shared world state.
paragraphs.zh: ME-World 致力于解决具身多智能体世界建模问题，其中 N 个智能体在同一个不断演化的共享世界中行动与互动，并从各自以自我为中心的观点进行观察。 给定每个智能体的未来具身动作序列、文本提示、初始自我视角帧和观察历史，我们的目标是生成所有智能体的未来自我视角流，其中每个流都遵循其自身的动作，且所有流都与同一个共享环境和共享世界状态保持一致。

paragraphs.en: The formulation is general to N N agents, but for clarity we present the two-agent case used in our experiments. The key challenge is that each agent observes only a partial view of the world, while the generated streams must agree on the shared environment, the agents’ actions, and interaction-induced state changes. To address this, ME-World couples ego streams through joint multi-agent generation (Sec. 3.2 ), guides them with shared action conditioning (Sec. 3.3 ), and grounds them with shared environment memory (Sec. 3.4 ). sents.zh: 为解决此问题，ME-World 通过联合多智能体生成（第 3.2 节）将自我视角流耦合起来，利用共享行动条件引导它们（第 3.3 节），并通过共享环境记忆将其锚定（第 3.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Since agents interact within the same environment, their ego streams are not independent. When an action changes the state of an agent, object, or region, this update should be reflected in all relevant ego streams rather than resolved separately per stream. We therefore generate all streams jointly within a single pretrained video diffusion transformer (DiT) ( Ali et al., 2025 ) , as shown in Fig. 3 (b). Rather than generating each stream independently, the model jointly denoises their latent sequences under the conditioning C C , allowing cross-stream information exchange. Formally, it learns the joint conditional distribution p θ ​ ( X ( 1 ) , … , X ( N ) ∣ C ) p_{\theta}(X^{(1)},\dots,X^{(N)}\mid C) , where θ \theta denotes the model parameters.

paragraphs.en: The DiT processes this joint sequence with self-attention, allowing evidence from one ego stream to inform others, so all streams evolve as mutually informed observations of the same shared world rather than isolated videos. Within this joint sequence, however, the model must still identify which stream each token belongs to and which conditions it should follow. We apply identical rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) ( Su et al., 2023 ) to all streams, aligning their space-time positions in a common positional frame, and distinguish the streams by adding a learnable agent embedding e ( n ) e^{(n)} to the tokens of n n -th agent. For text conditioning, each stream uses a separate cross-attention path, since different agents may observe different regions of the same scene. Each stream thus follows its own prompt P ( n ) P^{(n)} , while visual information is shared through joint self-attention.
paragraphs.zh: DiT 通过自注意力机制处理这一联合序列，使得一个自我流中的证据能够影响其他流，因此所有流都作为对同一共享世界的相互关联的观察而演化，而非孤立的视频。 然而，在这一联合序列中，模型仍需确定每个标记属于哪个流，以及它应遵循哪些条件。 我们对所有流应用相同的旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）（Su et al., 2023），将它们的时空位置对齐到一个共同的位置框架中，并通过为第 n 个智能体的标记添加一个可学习的智能体嵌入 e^{(n)} 来区分各流。 对于文本条件输入，每个流使用独立的交叉注意力路径，因为不同智能体可能观察到同一场景的不同区域。 因此，每个流都遵循其自身的提示 P^{(n)}，而视觉信息则通过联合自注意力机制共享。

paragraphs.en: Joint generation allows ego streams to exchange information through self-attention, but does not specify how each agent should move in the shared world . A straightforward method is to condition each ego stream on its own action, treating the action as private to the stream. However, in multi-agent generation, an agent’s action is also observed from other agents’ viewpoints and can change the shared world state via interaction. If each stream receives only its own action, the same embodied interaction may be rendered inconsistently across viewpoints. We therefore use shared action conditioning , guiding each ego stream with all agent’s motion rather than by its own action alone.
paragraphs.zh: 联合生成允许自我流通过自注意力交换信息，但并未明确每个智能体应在共享世界中如何移动。 一种直接的方法是将每个自我流的条件化于其自身的动作，并将该动作视为该自我流的私有信息。 然而，在多智能体生成中，一个智能体的动作也会从其他智能体的视角被观察到，并可能通过交互改变共享世界的状态。 如果每个自我流仅接收自身动作的信息，相同的具身交互在不同视角下可能会被不一致地呈现。 因此，我们采用共享动作条件化方法，用所有智能体的运动来引导每个自我流，而不仅仅是其自身的动作。

paragraphs.en: Shared action conditioning makes the agents’ actions explicit, but it does not tell the model what the surrounding world should look like . Even with joint self-attention, each ego stream still observes only a partial view, so the model may lack a common reference for scene layout, background appearance, and object state. We therefore introduce shared environment memory from the shared observation-history pool E E , which aggregates the observation histories of all agents.
paragraphs.zh: 共享动作条件化使智能体的动作变得明确，但它并未告诉模型周围的世界应该是什么样子。 即使使用了联合自注意力机制，每个自我流仍然只能观察到部分场景，因此模型可能缺乏对场景布局、背景外观和物体状态的共同参考。 因此，我们从共享观察历史池 E E 中引入共享环境记忆，该池汇集了所有智能体的观察历史。

paragraphs.en: A straightforward way to use this memory is to feed the selected history images as reference images. paragraphs.en: Existing multi-agent world models evaluate cross-view consistency using geometric agreement or VLM-based judgments ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026b ; Savva et al., 2026 ) . However, such consistency can arise directly from shared input conditions, making it difficult to isolate the consistency established by the model itself. Distinguishing this consistency is critical for assessing whether the model can maintain a shared environment beyond the explicit input. We therefore introduce S env S_{\text{env}} , which measures environment consistency only in regions not directly provided by geometric memory. Beyond the environment itself, a coherent shared world should consistently reflect interaction-induced state changes across agent views, which we measure with S update S_{\text{update}} . It should also preserve the identity of each agent when observed from different viewpoints, which we measure with S id S_{\text{id}} .

paragraphs.en: Model and Training Setup. We initialize from the Cosmos-Predict2.5 2B ( Ali et al., 2025 ) multi-view diffusion transformer. We train separate models on fine-tuning the DiT and conditioning modules while keeping the video VAE and text encoder frozen. We use the rectified-flow objective with AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) , a learning rate of 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} , and a global batch size of 4 on four A100 GPUs. At inference, we use 35 denoising steps and a classifier-free guidance scale of 7.0. Further details are provided in Appendix D.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 模型与训练设置。 我们从 Cosmos-Predict2.5 2B（Ali 等人，2025）多视角扩散变换器进行初始化。 我们在微调 DiT 和条件模块时训练独立的模型，同时保持视频 VAE 和文本编码器冻结不变。 我们使用修正流目标函数，结合 AdamW（Loshchilov 和 Hutter，2019），学习率设为 3 × 10⁻⁵，并在四块 A100 GPU 上使用全局批量大小为 4。 在推理阶段，我们使用 35 个去噪步骤和 7.0 的无分类器引导尺度。 更多细节请参见附录 D.2。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Metrics. We also evaluate camera control, self-action control, other-agent action control, and video quality. For camera control, we use Translation Error (Trans. Err) and Rotation Error (Rot. Err). Following E 3 C ( Gu et al., 2026 ) , self-action control measures the agent’s hand presence and alignment using Hand-F1 and Hand-mIoU, while other-agent action control measures the visibility and pose alignment using Full-Body-F1 and PCK@10. For video quality, we report PSNR ( Huynh-Thu and Ghanbari, 2008 ) , SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , and FVD ( Unterthiner et al., 2019 ) . Additional details are provided in Appendix B.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 评估指标。我们还对相机控制、自身动作控制、其他智能体动作控制以及视频质量进行了评估。对于相机控制，我们使用平移误差（Trans. Err）和旋转误差（Rot. Err）。遵循 E 3 C（Gu et al., 2026），自身动作控制通过 Hand-F1 和 Hand-mIoU 来衡量智能体的手部存在与对齐情况，而其他智能体动作控制则通过 Full-Body-F1 和 PCK@10 来衡量可见性与姿态对齐情况。对于视频质量，我们报告了 PSNR（Huynh-Thu and Ghanbari, 2008）、SSIM（Wang et al., 2004）、LPIPS（Zhang et al., 2018）和 FVD（Unterthiner et al., 2019）。更多细节请参见附录 B.2。

paragraphs.en: Real Benchmark. Tab. 1 and Fig. 5 compare ME-World with multi-view generation models ( Ren et al., 2025 ; Van Hoorick et al., 2026 ) , single-ego world models ( Hao et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and general world models ( DreamX Team et al., 2026 ; Robbyant Team et al., 2026 ) on the real ( Gavryushin et al., 2026 ) and synthetic benchmarks. Multi-view methods use one agent’s ground-truth ego stream as a reference, but still show lower shared-world consistency and blurry or ghosted actions, indicating that reference-stream synthesis alone cannot resolve interactions across agents. Single-ego world models follow the target agent’s action, but lack conditioning for the other agent, leading to weaker other-agent action control and mismatched motions under dynamic viewpoints. General world models generate plausible individual streams, but often fail to keep the two ego streams consistent in environment and interaction outcomes. In contrast, ME-World consistently improves shared-world consistency, self- and other-agent action control, and video quality while producing coherent scenes and synchronized interactions. Additional results are in Appendix A.1 .

paragraphs.en: We introduced multi-agent egocentric world modeling, where multiple agents interact in a shared world through their own egocentric viewpoints. We proposed ME-World , which jointly generates ego streams with shared action conditioning and environment memory. We also constructed real and synthetic benchmarks with shared-world consistency metrics. Experiments show that ME-World improves shared-world consistency and fine-grained action control while maintaining strong video quality, highlighting the importance of modeling ego streams as coupled observations of an evolving world. Our framework offers several directions for extension. Jointly modeling actions and observations could enable agents to plan behaviors and anticipate their effects on the shared world, while efficient cross-agent communication and memory could support larger groups. Combined with efficient video generation, these extensions could enable real-time, interactive multi-agent world simulation. We hope this work advances world models toward simulating multiple embodied agents in a persistent and evolving world.

paragraphs.en: Multi-Agent Generation. Our framework extends naturally to a larger number of agents without modifying the underlying architecture. To add a third agent, we simply append an additional ego stream and its corresponding agent token, project the third agent’s body and hand poses into each ego view in the same manner as in the two-agent setting, and include the resulting conditions in joint generation. paragraphs.en: Autoregressive Generation. We further extend generation along the temporal dimension by autoregressively chaining multiple generation chunks. As shown in Fig. 10 (bottom), this produces a 221-frame two-agent sequence while maintaining the interacting agents and shared environment over the extended horizon. Each subsequent chunk is conditioned on two frames from the preceding generated chunk, while generation within each chunk remains bidirectional. To improve robustness to imperfect generated context, we perturb the conditional latents during training. We randomly condition on one or two frames, and when two frames are used, independent Gaussian noise with standard deviation 0.1 0.1 is applied with probability 0.5 0.5 . paragraphs.en: Camera Control. For other-agent action control, we detect the interaction partner and estimate body keypoints using YOLOX ( Ge et al., 2021 ) and ViTPose ( Xu et al., 2022 ) . We report Full-Body-F1 for partner detection and Full-Body-PCK@10 for pose alignment over matched detections.

paragraphs.en: GEN3C ( Ren et al., 2025 ) . We use the GEN3C-Cosmos-7B checkpoint ( 704 × 1280 704\times 1280 , 121-frame chunks). For each generation direction, we construct a per-frame 4D cache from the source view’s ground-truth RGB video, metric depth estimated by DA3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , and ground-truth camera parameters. paragraphs.en: MultiWorld ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . We adapt MultiWorld to our embodied multi-agent setting using the same video backbone, training data, and Shared Action Conditioning as ME-World. We retain our Joint Multi-Agent Generation, jointly denoising the two ego streams through full self-attention over the concatenated stream tokens. For environment conditioning, we replace our Shared Environment Memory with MultiWorld’s VGGT-based Global State Encoder. We extract a shared global representation from the observation history using frozen VGGT features and inject the resulting representation into the ego streams through cross-attention. Our stream-aligned geometric memory and cross-stream anchor memory are not used in this adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: MultiWorld (Wu 等人，2026)。 我们采用与 ME-World 相同的视频主干网络、训练数据和共享动作条件机制，将 MultiWorld 适配到我们的具身多智能体设置中。 我们保留了联合多智能体生成方法，通过拼接后的流令牌上的完整自注意力机制，对两条自我视角流进行联合去噪。 在环境条件处理方面，我们将共享环境记忆替换为 MultiWorld 基于 VGGT 的全局状态编码器。 我们使用冻结的 VGGT 特征从观察历史中提取共享全局表示，并通过交叉注意力将所得表示注入到自我视角流中。 在此适配过程中，我们的流对齐几何记忆和跨流锚点记忆未被使用。

Unlike ME-World, this adaptation does not use an additional explicit environment-conditioning module. It therefore corresponds to joint multi-agent generation with Shared Action Conditioning but without Shared Environment Memory.

paragraphs.en: γ \gamma -World ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . We adapt γ \gamma -World using the same backbone, training data, and Shared Action Conditioning as ME-World. Instead of our Joint Multi-Agent Generation, we retain γ \gamma -World’s multi-agent interaction mechanism based on Sparse Hub Attention and Simplex Rotary Agent Encoding. paragraphs.en: We construct training data from both synthetic multi-person interactions and real-world synchronized egocentric recordings, as illustrated in Fig. 12 . paragraphs.en: To complement the limited diversity of real data, we construct synchronized egocentric video pairs from interacting avatars in shared 3D environments, as illustrated in Fig. 12 (a). As illustrated in Fig. 13 , paired human motions are retargeted to rigged avatars, placed into diverse scenes, and rendered synchronously from two head-mounted cameras. The rendered geometry and poses allow us to construct the same conditioning modalities used for real data, together with shared posed reference images.
paragraphs.zh: 为了补充真实数据有限的多样性，我们从共享三维环境中相互作用的虚拟角色中构建同步的第一人称视角视频对，如图 12 (a) 所示。 如图 13 所示，成对的人类动作被重新映射到已绑定骨骼的虚拟角色上，并置于不同场景中，通过两台头戴式摄像头同步渲染。 渲染出的几何形状和姿态使我们能够构建与真实数据相同的条件模态，同时还包括共享的姿态参考图像。

paragraphs.en: Assets and Motion Retargeting. We use 1,822 two-person interaction sequences from Inter-X ( Xu et al., 2024 ) (1,372 sequences across 40 categories) and InterHuman ( Liang et al., 2024 ) (450 sequences), resampled to 10 FPS. We collect 100 rigged VRM avatars and seven indoor and outdoor Blender environments. For each sequence, we randomly assign two avatars and transfer the SMPL-X motion to their skeletons. Because avatar body proportions can differ substantially from the source motions, we adapt the retargeted arm motion according to avatar limb lengths. Analytic two-bone inverse kinematics further aligns the wrists with their source trajectories, reducing contact errors in interactions such as handshakes. Finger articulation is transferred separately using relative joint flexion, and the retargeted pair is vertically aligned to the scene floor.
paragraphs.zh: 资产与动作重定向。 我们使用了来自 Inter-X (Xu et al., 2024)（40 个类别中的 1,372 个序列）和 InterHuman (Liang et al., 2024)（450 个序列）的 1,822 条双人互动序列，并以 10 FPS 重新采样。 我们收集了 100 个已绑定骨骼的 VRM 虚拟角色，以及七个室内和室外的 Blender 环境。 对于每个序列，我们会随机分配两个虚拟角色，并将 SMPL-X 的动作转移到它们的骨骼上。 由于虚拟角色的身体比例可能与源动作存在显著差异，因此我们会根据虚拟角色的肢体长度调整重定向后的手臂动作。 解析性的双骨逆运动学进一步使手腕与源轨迹对齐，从而减少了握手等互动中的接触误差。 手指关节则通过相对关节屈曲单独转移，且重定向后的成对动作会与场景地面垂直对齐。

paragraphs.en: Scene Placement and Rendering. We define scene anchors with valid standing positions and orientations and transform each interaction into a canonical pair-centric coordinate system before placement. Ray casting estimates available free space around each anchor, allowing motion trajectories to be assigned only to geometrically compatible locations. We discard placements with frequent camera–geometry intersections, yielding 53 validated scene configurations across the seven environments. For compatible placements, we additionally favor configurations with sufficient mutual view coverage between the two agents, which provides useful shared visual evidence for multi-ego generation.
paragraphs.zh: 场景布置与渲染。 我们使用有效的站立位置和朝向来定义场景锚点，并在布置前将每次交互转换到一个标准的以配对为中心的坐标系中。 通过射线投射可估算每个锚点周围的可用自由空间，从而仅能将运动轨迹分配给几何上兼容的位置。 我们舍弃了摄像机与几何体频繁相交的布置方案，最终在七个环境中得到了 53 种经过验证的场景配置。 对于兼容的布置方案，我们还优先选择两个智能体之间具有足够相互视野覆盖的配置，这能为多视角生成提供有用的共享视觉证据。

paragraphs.en: We attach a head-mounted camera to each avatar and synchronously render the two egocentric streams with a 100 ∘ 100^{\circ} horizontal field of view at 504 × 504 504\times 504 resolution and 10 FPS using Blender EEVEE. paragraphs.zh: 我们为每个虚拟形象安装一个头戴式摄像头，并使用 Blender EEVEE 同步渲染两条以自我为中心的视频流：水平视场角为 100°、分辨率为 504×504、帧率为 10 FPS。 佩戴者自身的头部几何模型会被其摄像头隐藏，以避免靠近摄像头处出现视觉伪影。 RGB 图像、度量深度和人物实例掩码被联合渲染。 虚拟形象的动画和摄像头在整个交互过程中通过关键帧进行控制，以确保两条自我视角视频流在时间上完全同步。

paragraphs.en: Condition Extraction. We divide the rendered sequences into non-overlapping 77-frame windows and construct the conditioning modalities used by our model. For explicit scene conditioning, we select observations from the available history according to their target-view reprojection coverage. Human pixels are removed using the rendered instance masks before back-projecting the remaining RGB-D observations into 3D and reprojecting them into each target camera. This produces the warped scene observation and its corresponding visibility mask.
paragraphs.zh: 条件提取。 我们将渲染后的序列划分为不重叠的 77 帧窗口，并构建模型所使用的条件模态。 对于显式场景条件，我们根据可用历史数据中目标视角的重投影覆盖情况选择观察结果。 在将剩余的 RGB-D 观察结果反向投影到三维空间并重新投影到每个目标相机之前，我们使用渲染出的实例掩码移除人类像素。 这样便生成了形变的场景观察结果及其对应的可见性掩码。

Because the underlying interaction is already specified by the pose conditioning, we use a generic first-person interaction prompt for synthetic training samples.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还通过选择两个流中共享的八条干净的参考观察信息，来构建隐式共享环境记忆。 参考信息的选取采用贪心策略，以最大化对两个目标自我视角的场景覆盖互补性。 对于每条参考信息，我们保留其 RGB 图像、相机状态以及身份颜色编码的姿态条件。 由于底层的交互关系已由姿态条件明确指定，因此我们在合成训练样本中使用通用的第一人称交互提示。

paragraphs.en: Quality Control and Dataset Statistics. We filter sequences with invalid viewing conditions, prolonged extreme partner proximity, or severe camera–geometry intersections. A wall-intrusion score based on near-camera scene geometry provides an additional check for cases in which the virtual head-mounted camera enters scene surfaces. The resulting synthetic corpus contains 4,736 paired 77-frame clips, corresponding to 9,472 egocentric videos, generated from 1,822 interaction sequences, 100 avatars, seven environments, and 53 validated scene configurations. All videos are rendered at 10 FPS and 504 × 504 504\times 504 resolution.

paragraphs.en: Moving people must not be treated as part of the persistent scene memory. paragraphs.en: Cross-Stream Anchor Memory Construction. In addition to stream-aligned geometric memory, we construct clean reference observations that provide complementary appearance information about the shared environment. The resulting references are shared by both generated streams and form the implicit reference memory used by our model.

paragraphs.en: Real Benchmark. We sample 100 clips from the official validation split of CoMind ( Gavryushin et al., 2026 ) . These recordings are disjoint from our training data and contain unseen kitchens and participants. We process them using the same geometry, pose, and camera pipeline described above and extract synchronized 77-frame windows from the two ego streams. All metrics are computed at 480 × 480 480\times 480 resolution. We exclude clips with hair occluding the ego camera, mean cross-view co-visibility below 0.075, or fewer than 10 partner-visible frames in both views. Co-visibility is computed through cross-view depth reprojection using the recorded cameras with a 10 cm depth-consistency tolerance. To avoid concentrating the benchmark on a narrow range of viewpoint overlap, we allocate recording-level quotas proportional to each recording’s eligible candidate pool, yielding 28, 25, and 47 clips. Within each recording, candidates are sorted by co-visibility, divided into equal-count strata, and randomly sampled across these strata. The resulting benchmark has a mean cross-view co-visibility of 0.38 and a median of 43 partner-visible frames per clip.
paragraphs.zh: 真实基准测试。 我们从 CoMind（Gavryushin 等人，2026）的官方验证集中采样了 100 个片段。 这些录像与我们的训练数据相互独立，并包含未出现过的厨房和参与者。 我们使用上文描述的相同几何、姿态和相机处理流程对这些录像进行处理，并从两条第一人称视角流中提取同步的 77 帧窗口。 所有指标均在 480 × 480 分辨率下计算。 我们排除了头发遮挡第一人称视角相机、跨视角平均共视性低于 0.075，或两个视角中伴侣可见帧数少于 10 帧的片段。 共视性通过跨视角深度重投影计算，使用记录时的相机，并设置 10 厘米的深度一致性容差。 为避免基准测试集中在狭窄的视角重叠范围内，我们按各录像的合格候选池比例分配录像级配额，最终得到 28、25 和 47 个片段。 在每个录像中，候选项按共视性排序，分为数量相等的分层，并在这些分层中进行随机采样。 最终的基准测试具有 0.38 的平均跨视角共视性和每个片段 43 帧的伴侣可见帧数中位数。

paragraphs.en: Synthetic Benchmark. We construct 100 evaluation clips using the same rendering and conditioning pipeline as our synthetic training data while using held-out assets. The benchmark spans six Poly Haven ( Poly Haven, 2026 ) environments: Hidden Alley, Verdant Trail, The Shed, Namaqualand, Pawn Shop, and Pine Forest. Candidate windows must contain at least 10 partner-visible frames with at least six body joints inside the image, and must have mean cross-view co-visibility of at least 0.05. We retain at most one window from each interaction sequence to avoid near-duplicate samples. Scene-level quotas are assigned proportional to the eligible validation pool, resulting in 14, 23, 18, 14, 19, and 12 clips for the six scenes, respectively. Within each scene, we perform stratified sampling by co-visibility following the real benchmark protocol. The resulting synthetic benchmark contains 100 distinct interaction sequences, including 84 from Inter-X and 16 from InterHuman, across 86 avatar pairs. It has a mean cross-view co-visibility of 0.31 and provides exact camera, depth, segmentation, pose, and identity annotations for controlled evaluation.

paragraphs.en: Model Configuration. We initialize ME-World from the Cosmos-Predict2.5 2B ( Ali et al., 2025 ) multi-view diffusion transformer, with a frozen Wan-2.1 causal video VAE and Cosmos-Reason1 7B text encoder. Each training sample contains two synchronized 77-frame ego streams at 480 × 480 480\times 480 resolution and 10 FPS, encoded into 20 latent frames per view. We use first-frame conditioning and four shared references selected by greedy coverage maximization over both views.
paragraphs.zh: 模型配置。 我们从 Cosmos-Predict2.5 2B（Ali 等人，2025）多视角扩散变换器初始化 ME-World，并搭配一个冻结的 Wan-2.1 因果视频 VAE 和 Cosmos-Reason1 7B 文本编码器。 每个训练样本包含两条同步的 77 帧第一人称视角流，分辨率为 480 × 480，帧率为 10 FPS，并编码为每视角 20 个潜在帧。 我们使用首帧条件约束，并从两个视角中通过贪心覆盖最大化选择四个共享参考。

sents.en: We use first-frame conditioning and four shared references selected by greedy coverage maximization over both views.

paragraphs.en: Training. We train separate checkpoints for Real and Synthetic, using CoMind and our synthetic dataset, respectively, without transferring weights between them. For each model, we fine-tune the DiT and conditioning modules using the rectified-flow objective, applying the loss only to generated latent frames. We use AdamW with a learning rate of 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} , weight decay 10 − 3 10^{-3} , 100 warm-up steps, and linear learning-rate decay. Training uses BF16 and FSDP on four A100 80 GB GPUs with a global batch size of 4. We maintain an exponential moving average (EMA) of the model weights.
paragraphs.zh: 训练。 我们分别为真实数据和合成数据训练独立的检查点，分别使用 CoMind 和我们的合成数据集，且不在两者之间转移权重。 对于每个模型，我们使用修正流目标函数对 DiT 和条件模块进行微调，并将损失仅应用于生成的潜在帧。 我们使用 AdamW，学习率为 3 × 10⁻⁵，权重衰减为 10⁻³，包含 100 个预热步长和线性学习率衰减。 训练过程在四块 A100 80 GB GPU 上使用 BF16 和 FSDP，全局批量大小为 4。 我们维护模型权重的指数移动平均（EMA）。
